title: Bounded Loop Search
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine with $k$ work tapes over Boolean symbols, let $(c_j)_{j\in\mathbb N}$ be a sequence of configurations on a fixed Boolean input, let $A(j)$ be a Boolean-valued acceptance test, and let $P(j)$ be a Boolean word for each $j$. For natural numbers $B,N$, suppose the configuration $c_N$ is halted with empty output, and for every $j<N$ there is a time at most $B$ such that either the run from $c_j$ halts with output $P(j)$ when $A(j)$ holds, or reaches exactly $c_{j+1}$ when $A(j)$ fails. Then the run from $c_0$ halts within $NB$ steps, with output $P(i)$ for the first index $i<N$ satisfying $A(i)$, if such an index exists, and with empty output if none exists.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $k$ of work tapes
